title: NextGen Bank - Service Overview
description: Uptime, latency, SLI/SLO, error rates, failed vs successful requests, containers & nodes, business KPIs, logs and traces.

panels.title: Availability SLI
panels.description: Share of requests that did not fail with a 5xx. SLO: 99.5%

panels.title: Error burn rate (5m)
panels.description: 1 = burning exactly at the SLO rate

targets.expr: sum(increase(span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service", http_status_code=~"[23].."}[$__range])) or sum(increase(span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"[23].."}[$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(increase(span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service", http_status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) or sum(increase(span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Click an exemplar to open the trace in Tempo

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service"}[15m]))))

panels.title: Transactions per minute by type / status
Business KPIs - from the database (read-only Grafana role)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM bankaccount WHERE account_status = 'Active'
SELECT count(*) FROM bankaccount WHERE account_status = 'Pending'
SELECT COALESCE(sum(balance),0) FROM bankaccount WHERE account_status = 'Active' AND currency = 'USD'
SELECT count(*) FROM "transaction" WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount),0) FROM "transaction" WHERE status = 'Completed' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) FROM virtualcard WHERE card_status = 'Active'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,'1h'), count(*) AS "all", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Completed') AS completed FROM "transaction" WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT currency, count(*) AS accounts, round(sum(balance)::numeric,2) AS total_balance FROM bankaccount WHERE account_status = 'Active' GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency
